articles.title: Six killed in Russian drone and missile attacks in Kyiv and other cities
articles.summary: Russia launched extensive ballistic missile, drone, and guided bomb attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities on Sunday. Authorities reported at least six people killed and dozens wounded. These continuous assaults underscore the brutal reality of the ongoing conflict, highlighting the severe impact on Ukrainian civilians and infrastructure, demonstrating persistent military engagement.

articles.title: Post script: Felix Larkin on Ireland’s stamps celebrating US connections
articles.summary: An Post, Ireland's postal service, commemorated the 250th anniversary of the United States Declaration of Independence with a special stamp. The stamp prominently features John Dunlap, the printer of the Declaration's initial copies. This philatelic release honors a pivotal moment in American history, underscoring historical ties and cultural recognition on an international platform.

articles.title: Inside Helsinki's bunker city with enough space for a MILLION people if Putin launches a nuke
articles.summary: Beneath Helsinki, Finland, lies a vast, dormant 'second city' – a network of underground shelters and critical infrastructure designed for activation during disaster.
